purpose: Add validated NGBoost probabilistic uncertainty to Step 27 Random Forest future forecasts.
uncertainty_level_threshold_source: Frozen 2024 relative interval-width thresholds created in Step 21B.
deployment_training_rule: After final evaluation was frozen, NGBoost was retrained on all labels whose target date was available through 2025-12.
future_predictor_state: Exactly reuses Step 27 future predictor projection.
future_target_state: Exactly reuses Step 27 H1 Random Forest recursive future Malnutrition_Cases state.
important_interpretation: The NGBoost 95% interval is a probabilistic NGBoost prediction interval. It is not a formal Random Forest confidence interval and it does not guarantee that 95% of 2026-2030 future observations will fall inside the interval.
future_validation_limitation: Actual 2026-2030 outcomes are not yet available. Therefore future observed interval coverage cannot be calculated now. Step 21B unseen-2025 coverage is retained as the latest empirical calibration evidence.
